TransitionGate_decide.signature: decide(self, input_graph: SlotGraph, target_layer: Layer, evidence: EvidenceContract) -> TransitionVerdict
ordered_decision_steps: 1. Gamma consultation — gamma(graph: SlotGraph) called INTERNALLY; Γ refusal maps to gate verdict table
2. Forbidden Straight-Line Registry — CERTIFICATE target through generic gate = FORBIDDEN_LEAP (fatal)
3. Ungated rank claim — generation_source != TRANSITION_VERDICT above UNGATED_RANK_CEILING = REJECTED
4. Evidence presence — empty evidence surface = DEFERRED/GATE_REQUIRED (retryable)
5. §8 meet — granted = meet(evidence_rank, identity_rank, gate_rank, residual_ceiling) — can only keep or lower
6. Approval — APPROVED with granted_rank; failure_code = None
TransitionGate_decide.short_circuit: First refusal at step k stops all subsequent steps
TransitionGate_decide.gamma_call_order: gamma() called INTERNALLY by decide() via SlotGraph — callers must NOT call gamma() separately before decide()
